metas.description: In November 1919, two soldiers--a disfigured but brilliant artist and an ex-accountant--start a memorial con. But in Roaring Twenties France, their adventures soon turn dangerous.

metas.name: Jerry and Marge Go Large
metas.description: Based on the true story about long-married couple Jerry and Marge Selbee, who win the lottery and use the money to revive their small town.
